# source: color manual (color.pdf) §1 — defining and using colours, boxes,
# page colour.
pre impl \definecolor{c}{rgb}{1,0,0}
body impl \textcolor{black}{x}
body impl {\color{black} x}
body refuse:W0301 \colorbox{black}{x}
body refuse:W0301 \fcolorbox{black}{white}{x}
pre impl \pagecolor{black}
body impl \nopagecolor
